units.source_text: 此时暮色沉沉，夜天澄碧。

en.t: By now dusk had settled deeply, and the night sky was clear and blue.

units.source_text: 阶前秋草，焜黄欲萎。

en.t: The autumn grasses before the steps had turned yellow and were about to wither.

units.source_text: 四壁虫声，哀音似诉。

en.t: From around the walls came the cries of insects, mournful as if they were making a complaint.

units.source_text: 满庭红叶，幽艳如锦。

en.t: The courtyard was full of crimson leaves, quietly brilliant like brocade.

units.source_text: 此景真堪入画。

en.t: The scene truly deserved to be painted.

units.source_text: 右近环顾四周，觉得自身忽然处此境中，甚是意外。

en.t: Ukon looked around and felt it very strange to find herself suddenly in such surroundings.

units.source_text: 回想夕颜五条的陋屋，不免羞耻。

en.t: When she remembered Yugao's poor house at Gojo, she could not help feeling ashamed.

units.source_text: 竹林中有几只鸽子，鸣声粗鲁刺耳。

en.t: There were several pigeons in the bamboo grove, and their calls were coarse and grating.

units.source_text: 源氏公子听了，回想起那天和夕颜在某院泊宿时，夕颜听到这种鸟声非常恐怖的样子，觉得很可怜。

en.t: Hearing them, Prince Genji remembered how frightened Yugao had been by such bird calls when they spent the night together at that deserted villa, and he felt deep pity for her.

units.source_text: 他对右近说：“她究竟几岁了？

en.t: He said to Ukon, "How old was she, after all?

units.source_text: 这个人和一般人不同，异常纤弱，所以不能长生。”

en.t: She was unlike ordinary people, so unusually fragile that she could not live long."

units.source_text: 右近答道：“十九岁吧。

en.t: Ukon answered, "She was probably nineteen.

units.source_text: 我母亲——小姐的乳母[\[36\]](#part1333.html#m36)——抛撇了我而死去，小姐的父亲中将大人可怜我，留我在小姐身边，两人时刻不离，一起长大。

en.t: My mother, who was my lady's nurse[\[36\]](#part1333.html#m36), left me behind when she died, and my lady's father, the Middle Captain, took pity on me and kept me at her side, so the two of us were never apart and grew up together.

units.source_text: 现在小姐已死，我怎么还生存在这世间呢？

en.t: Now that my lady is dead, how can I still be alive in this world?

units.source_text: 悔不该与她生前过分亲近，反教死别徒增痛苦。

en.t: I regret having been so close to her while she lived, for it has only made the pain of parting by death greater.

units.source_text: 这位柔弱的小姐，原是多年来和我相依为命的主人。”

en.t: This delicate lady was the mistress with whom I had depended on each other for so many years."

units.source_text: 源氏公子说：“柔弱，就女子而言是可爱的。

en.t: Prince Genji said, "In a woman, delicacy is lovable.

units.source_text: 自作聪明、不信人言的人，才教人不快。

en.t: It is people who think themselves clever and refuse to trust what others say who are unpleasant.

units.source_text: 我自己生性柔弱，没有决断，所以喜欢柔弱的人。

en.t: I myself am gentle by nature and lack decisiveness, and so I like gentle people.

units.source_text: 这种人虽然一不小心会受男子欺骗，可是本性谦恭谨慎，善于体贴丈夫的心情，所以可喜。

en.t: Such a person may be deceived by a man if she is not careful, but because her nature is modest and cautious and she understands her husband's feelings well, she is pleasing.

units.source_text: 倘能随心所欲地加以教养，正是最可爱的性格。”

en.t: If one could guide and nurture her as one wished, it would be the most lovable character of all."

units.source_text: 右近说：“公子喜欢这种性格，小姐正是最适当的人物，可惜短命而死。”

en.t: Ukon said, "If you favor that sort of character, my lady was exactly the right person, but sadly she died young."

units.source_text: 说罢掩面而泣。

en.t: After saying this, she covered her face and wept.
